points.description: Hue (H) is used for segmentation, with a narrow range around 0/360 degrees (red, hue 0). Equivalent wording, such as a hue band close to 0 or 360 or red hue values, earns the mark.
Saturation (S) is used, with a high range close to 0.8–1 (near-pure colour). Equivalent wording, such as saturation close to 1 or highly saturated, earns the mark.
Intensity (I) is used, with a broad range around 0.5. Equivalent wording, such as intensity near mid-range with wide tolerance, earns the mark.
